title: Let's try and switch to Azure OpenAI

cues.en: What if we instead want to consume Azure OpenAI instead of OpenAI?
cues.zh: 如果我們想使用 Azure OpenAI，而不是 OpenAI 呢？

cues.en: Well, we only need to switch out this top part, meaning this API key is not
cues.zh: 只需要替換最上面的部分。也就是說，這把 API 金鑰並不是

cues.en: Azure OpenAI, but instead we need another API key, and for Azure we also need an
cues.zh: Azure OpenAI 的金鑰，所以要換另一把；而且使用 Azure 還需要一個

cues.en: endpoint.
cues.zh: 端點。

cues.en: So, let's make ready for an endpoint, and let's go to ai.azure.com and get
cues.zh: 先準備好端點變數，再到 ai.azure.com 取得

cues.en: our credentials up here.
cues.zh: 認證資訊。

cues.en: If you don't have one of these, you can go in and say create new project, and then you have your new endpoint.
cues.zh: 如果你還沒有，可以按「建立新專案」，就能得到自己的端點。

cues.en: I already made mine here, and we need to do three things.
cues.zh: 我已經先建立好了。這裡需要做三件事。

cues.en: The first thing is we need to get our endpoint, and if we look at this endpoint, it has a name here.
cues.zh: 第一件事是取得端點。可以看到這個端點裡有一個名稱，

cues.en: In this case, my endpoint is this, and then it has some project part over here.
cues.zh: 我的端點就是這個，後面還有專案相關的部分。

cues.en: The project part we cannot use directly with a direct access model like this.
cues.zh: 如果像這樣直接存取模型，就不能直接使用這個專案部分。

cues.en: This is more for something called Microsoft Foundry, which we'll cover later in this series.
cues.zh: 這比較偏向 Microsoft Foundry 的用途，稍後課程會介紹。

cues.en: So, for now, we just take the endpoint and get rid of the slash API part down here, and then we get our API key, and again, I'm going to show you
cues.zh: 目前先複製端點，去掉後面的 /api 部分，再取得 API 金鑰。我同樣會展示

cues.en: my API key, but I will have revoked it before you see this video, and so
cues.zh: 我的 API 金鑰，但在你看到影片之前，我已經撤銷它，

cues.en: you can't use it for anything like this.
cues.zh: 所以這把金鑰無法再使用。

cues.en: So, this is what we need, and we need to talk with Azure instead of OpenAI, so we need an Azure OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 這就是需要的資料。因為要和 Azure 而非 OpenAI 通訊，所以需要 AzureOpenAIClient。

cues.en: That is an additional key up here, our NuGet package, which is called Azure.AI.OpenAI,
cues.zh: 為此要再加一個 NuGet 套件，名叫 Azure.AI.OpenAI，

cues.en: and we'll wrap that as well and put it in, and now the only thing we
cues.zh: 我們也把它安裝進來。接下來真正需要做的，

cues.en: really need to do is we need to say instead of OpenAI client, we need to say Azure OpenAI client, and have a new
cues.zh: 就是把 OpenAIClient 改成 AzureOpenAIClient，建立一個新的執行個體，

cues.en: of those, and provides an endpoint and
cues.zh: 並傳入端點和

cues.en: an API key.
cues.zh: API 金鑰。

cues.en: It is possible instead of an API key to also use the role-based access system
cues.zh: 除了 API 金鑰，也可以使用 Azure 的角色型存取控制機制，

cues.en: from Azure, but we'll cover that later on in the system, but it's essentially just using
cues.zh: 稍後會再介紹。基本上就是使用

cues.en: the Azure default credentials or Azure CLI credentials.
cues.zh: DefaultAzureCredential 或 AzureCliCredential。

cues.en: For now, we're going to use an API key, and we have our connection.
cues.zh: 目前先使用 API 金鑰，這樣就建立好連線了。

cues.en: The rest is actually exactly the same.
cues.zh: 其餘部分其實完全相同。

cues.en: The only thing is that in OpenAI, you don't need to deploy the model yourself.
cues.zh: 唯一差別是，在 OpenAI 不必自己部署模型。

cues.en: You need to do that in Azure, so what you need to do is you need to go to the portal again and go
cues.zh: 但在 Azure 必須部署，所以我們要回到入口網站，

cues.en: to the Build tab here, go to Models, and then Deploy a Model.
cues.zh: 切到 Build，進入 Models，再選「Deploy a Model」。

cues.en: You can see I've already deployed chat gpt-4.1-nano Nano here, gpt-5-nano, and Text-Embedding-3-Small,
cues.zh: 可以看到我已經部署了 gpt-4.1-nano、gpt-5-nano 和 text-embedding-3-small，

cues.en: which is the three ones we are going to use throughout this series.
cues.zh: 這三個模型會在整個系列中用到。

cues.en: But if you need to deploy a new model, you simply press Deploy here.
cues.zh: 如果要部署其他模型，只要按這裡的 Deploy。

cues.en: You get to choose among all the different models they have available, so that we wanted to need to deploy a ChatGPT.
cues.zh: 你可以從服務提供的各種模型中選擇。假設我們想部署一個 ChatGPT 模型，

cues.en: Let's find one of the mini models.
cues.zh: 找找看其中的 mini 模型。

cues.en: Let's say we wanted to deploy the 4.1 mini.
cues.zh: 例如部署 GPT-4.1 mini。

cues.en: We go to the Deploy tab here.
cues.zh: 進入這裡的 Deploy 頁籤。

cues.en: You can either deploy with default.
cues.zh: 可以採用預設部署設定。

cues.en: I tend to always do it with custom,
cues.zh: 我通常會選擇自訂設定，

cues.en: and we can choose how we want to deploy it using global settings or standard settings.
cues.zh: 然後選擇全域或標準等部署方式。

cues.en: This is beyond the scope of this video, how many tokens per minute we will allow, and we would deploy because else it wouldn't
cues.zh: 這些設定超出本段影片的範圍，包括每分鐘允許多少 Token。總之，必須先部署，否則

cues.en: understand it in Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: Azure OpenAI 就不會辨識這個模型。

cues.en: So they control what models can be chosen by the developer instead of in OpenAI, where
cues.zh: 也就是說，在 Azure 可以控制開發者能選用的模型；OpenAI 則是

cues.en: you just have access to all models.
cues.zh: 直接讓你存取各種模型。

cues.en: So if we run this code instead of OpenAI, we will see hopefully exactly the same outcome.
cues.zh: 改成 Azure OpenAI 後執行，理論上應該得到完全相同的結果。

cues.en: And as it says, the capital of France is Paris.
cues.zh: 就如畫面所示，法國的首都是巴黎。
